mark_type: the marks are ABSTRACT GEOMETRIC SYMBOLS built from primitive shapes — circles, semi-circles, triangles, squares, hexagons — joined or arranged into unique iconic forms; NO letterforms, NO recognizable type, NO monograms; each mark in the grid is a structurally distinct abstract symbol

the marks are COMPASS-AND-GRID abstract constructions built from a visible underlying circular grid, rotational or radial symmetry, evident geometric construction logic; think mid-century corporate identity marks like CBS eye or Chase octagon; NO letterforms, NO type

the marks are NEGATIVE-SPACE abstract silhouettes where the negative carries as much weight as the positive form — bold filled shapes with optical Gestalt figure-ground play; the marks are abstract symbols, NOT letterforms

the marks are ICONIC PICTOGRAPHIC abstractions of natural forms (mountain, wave, sun, star, leaf, flame, eye, arrow, droplet) reduced to clean geometric primitives; NO letterforms, NO type, NO realistic illustration
the marks are LINEAR MODULAR constructions built from straight bars, hairlines, and parallel strokes woven or stacked into abstract architectural symbols; NO letterforms, NO type

the marks are FLOWING ORGANIC abstract forms — soft curves, lobes, blobs, droplets, paramecium-like shapes joined into iconic abstract symbols; nature-derived but heavily reduced; NO letterforms, NO type
the marks are RADIAL/CIRCULAR abstract forms — rosettes, spokes, sunburst patterns, concentric ring constructions, mandala-derived geometry; NO letterforms, NO type

the marks are STACKED-PRIMITIVE chunky compositions — heavy filled circles, semi-circles, and rectangles stacked into iconic figures (think Memphis-design building blocks or Saul Bass abstract); NO letterforms

the marks are MODULAR TYPEFACE MONOGRAMS — single-letter or two-letter heavy display letterform construction with soft inverse cuts and tight kerning; this is the ONE register where letterforms ARE the subject
